name: vectorforge-codesearch-v1
description: Natural-language code search queries over the VectorForge demo corpus (this repository plus selected Go standard library packages).
provenance: Queries and relevance labels were written by the AI assistant that implemented VectorForge, from the file inventory and the source code, before any of these queries were run against the system. They were not tuned on system output. They are a small, single-annotator set: treat results as indicative, not as a benchmark.

grades.2: the file that implements or documents the answer
grades.1: a closely related file a developer would also accept

corpus_note: Document IDs are source:path. Test files are not labelled relevant unless the query is about tests. The query set lives in vectorforge/eval, which the demo sources exclude from ingestion.
